profile.headline: Talent Acquisition Consultant at Advantage Solutions
profile.summary:
I am an emerging IT Analyst professional, UI/UX Designer, and Web Developer, committed to building seamless digital experiences and driving innovation in technology. With a background in IT support, web development, and user-centered design, I have developed a strong foundation in troubleshooting technical issues, designing intuitive user interfaces, and developing functional web solutions.

I am passionate about optimizing both the technical and visual aspects of digital platforms, ensuring that users not only have a smooth and engaging experience but also benefit from the functionality and innovation that drive real business results. Whether it's creating user-friendly interfaces, solving complex technical challenges, or building responsive websites, I bring a solution-oriented mindset and a keen eye for detail to every project I undertake.

Currently, I am focused on advancing my expertise in IT analysis, UI/UX design, and web development, with a goal to continuously grow as a versatile and dynamic professional in the tech field. I am eager to collaborate with forward-thinking teams to create impactful, high-quality digital experiences that resonate with users and meet organizational goals.

positions.title: Talent Acquisition Consultant
positions.description:
Source and identify qualified candidates through Indeed, Affinix, Circa, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other recruiting platforms to support active hiring needs.

Maintain and update Excel-based productivity and recruiting reports, tracking daily activity and performance metrics.

Conduct candidate interviews using company-approved interview guides and standardized screening processes to assess qualifications, experience, and overall fit.

Communicate with candidates and internal stakeholders through Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams regarding job opportunities, interview coordination, and recruiting-related processes.

Document candidate information, interview feedback, and relevant screening notes to support accurate and organized recruiting records.

Collaborate with team members through Microsoft Teams to share information, provide process support, and maintain productivity across recruiting operations.

Utilize Oracle for timekeeping, required training, professional development, and access to company learning resources.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.locationName: New Haven County, Connecticut, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Delivered custom web development solutions for small businesses, utilizing technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.
Designed user-friendly interfaces focusing on accessibility and responsiveness, boosting client satisfaction by 40%.
Assisted in troubleshooting and improving existing codebases, reducing bugs by 25%.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · CSS3 · JavaScript · React.js · UI/UX · Node.js · REST APIs · Database Management System (DBMS) · Figma (Software) · Adobe XD · Git · GitHub

positions.title: Recruiter
positions.description:
Managed the recruitment process by sourcing, screening, and communicating with potential candidates for available job opportunities. 
 
 Conducted candidate outreach through phone, email, and other communication channels to identify qualified applicants. 
 
 Reviewed resumes, assessed candidate qualifications, and matched applicants with appropriate job openings. 
 
 Coordinated interviews and maintained communication between candidates and hiring managers. 
 
 Built relationships with candidates to understand their experience, skills, and employment goals. 
 
 Maintained accurate candidate records and updated applicant information within recruiting systems. 
 
 Provided guidance to candidates throughout the hiring process, including job expectations and next steps.
positions.insights: Skills: Recruiting · Technical Recruiting · Manufacturing · Warehouse Operations

positions.title: High Dosage Tutor
positions.description:
Provided individualized academic support by assessing student needs and creating customized learning strategies, demonstrating adaptability and a student-centered approach.
Effectively communicated complex material with clarity and empathy, fostering confidence and trust among diverse learners.
Monitored and evaluated student performance using data-driven insights, reflecting strong analytical skills and a focus on measurable progress.
Partnered with educators and administrators to enhance student outcomes, showcasing collaboration and excellent interpersonal communication.

positions.title: Human Resources Specialist
positions.description:
Managed Employee Database: Oversaw a large database of employee records, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality. This honed my skills in data management and database systems, crucial for IT roles.

Streamlined Medical Clearance: Facilitated digital workflows to process medical clearances for 400+ personnel weekly. Optimized systems for efficiency, directly aligning with IT process improvement and user-centered design.

Optimized Hiring Processes with Tech: Collaborated with the recruiting team to accelerate hiring timelines by 33%, integrating digital tools for smoother workflow and enhancing my problem-solving skills in IT and web development.

Trained Teams with Digital Tools: Trained associates using tech resources to meet business objectives. This experience deepened my understanding of user needs, important for UI/UX design.

Implemented IT Solutions for Efficiency: Created software workarounds to resolve technical issues, saving 8 hours weekly and improving team performance. Strengthened my ability to apply IT solutions for system optimization.

Managed Client Job Postings: Oversaw 150 weekly client job postings, ensuring accuracy and satisfaction via digital platforms. This reinforced my ability to manage digital content, a key skill for web development and UI/UX design.

Improved Job Templates for Engagement: Advocated for changes to job templates, increasing applicants by 16%. Focused on optimizing user interfaces for better interaction, a critical skill in UI/UX design.

Enhanced Templates with Bilingual Skills: Revamped job templates in both English and Spanish, improving diversity and outreach. Developed an understanding of designing for a global user base, essential for UI/UX design.

Mentored Associates with Digital Solutions: Mentored new associates using digital tools, reducing training costs by $7,500. This demonstrates my ability to leverage tech for improving business processes, relevant for both IT and web development roles.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Human Resources (HR) · Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) · Medical Terminology · U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) · COVID-19 · Microsot Team · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Word · Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
